exposure: Fetal tachycardia within 2 hours preceding the start of the second stage
outcome: Composite of severe adverse neonatal outcomes
cohort: The cohort consisted of 22,454 individuals with a singleton gestation at term (>37 weeks), a vertex-presenting, nonanomalous fetus, who planned a vaginal delivery and reached the start of the second stage of labor, delivering at two academic medical centers between July 2016 and June 2020.
finding: A logistic regression model effectively predicted adverse neonatal outcomes at the start of the second stage of labor, with meconium, fetal tachycardia, and number of prior deliveries being the strongest associated factors.
